name: Hotel Gabrielli Venezia, StarHotels
insider_take: This elegant palazzo sits just steps from St. Mark's Square, where centuries of Venetian grandeur meet modern luxury in one of the city's most coveted locations.
whats_special: Hotel Gabrielli occupies a stunning 15th-century Gothic palace with original Venetian terrazzo floors and period frescoes. The rooftop terrace restaurant offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Venetian lagoon and historic bell towers. Located on Riva degli Schiavoni, you're positioned on Venice's most famous waterfront promenade where Casanova once strolled.
pro_tip: Book a lagoon-view room on higher floors for unobstructed sunrise views over the water, and visit the rooftop terrace during golden hour when the entire city glows.
dont_miss: The hotel's private water taxi dock provides exclusive access directly from Marco Polo Airport. Take evening strolls along the Riva degli Schiavoni to the Bridge of Sighs, just a 3-minute walk away. The nearby Palazzo Ducale and Basilica di San Marco are virtually at your doorstep.
pros: Iconic 14th-century Gothic palazzo offering an authentic and storied Venetian atmosphere
Prime waterfront location on the Riva degli Schiavoni with stunning lagoon and gondola views
Rooftop terrace and al fresco dining with sweeping panoramic views of Venice and the lagoon
Steps from St. Mark's Square, the Doge's Palace, and top Venice landmarks
Elegant, classically styled rooms blending historic charm with modern comforts
cons: Central Venice location means no on-site parking; travel is exclusively by foot or water taxi
High season brings heavy tourist foot traffic directly outside the hotel along the waterfront promenade
